# Person Remover V1

Supply a **24 fps source video** and a **clean version of its first frame**, with identical size and framing. Make that clean frame externally with an image editor, ChatGPT ImageGen, or Qwen Image Edit.

Describe the person in CLIP Text Encode below, for example **man in gray shirt**. Native SAM3 uses that text to detect the target. SAM tracks that selection, expands the mask by 5 px, and fills it green. Check the mask preview before trusting a removal.

**Start with a short, single-shot clip.** Dimensions must be divisible by 32. The demonstrated runs use roughly 5-second clips. Camera cuts, hands, moving screens, shadows and disocclusions can still cause artifacts. The clean frame is a visual reference, not an exact pixel lock.

Green nodes are user inputs. Red nodes save outputs. Original node names are retained.

widgets_values:
## Describe the person

Use a short identifying phrase in the green CLIP Text Encode node: **man in gray shirt**, **woman wearing a red coat**, or **person**. The SAM checkpoint supplies its own text encoder. No point selector or KJ Nodes is required. If several people match, make the description more specific.

The first source frame feeds SAM automatically. Inspect the saved green-mask preview for missing hands, hair or a second person. Expand pixels starts at **5**; more expansion hides more edge pixels but asks H3 to reconstruct more background.

To preview only: set the clean-output Save Video node to Never; queue the mask output, then restore the clean output to Always.

## Model downloads and folders

[H3 Ref2VA INT8 ConvRot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`

[Qwen3VL NVFP4 AWQ](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`

[Video VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors) and [Audio VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/vae/`

[SAM 3.1 with text encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/blob/main/checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors) → `ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/`. Load Checkpoint supplies SAM model + CLIP from this one file.

Person Remover V1 → `ComfyUI/models/loras/H3-Person-Remover-V1.safetensors`. The adapter is separate from this code repository; its public release is pending. See docs/person-remover-v1.md for the B2000 SHA256.

Install the accompanying **H3 Relay** build into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/h3-relay`, then restart ComfyUI. Use a current ComfyUI with native H3 and SAM3 support. Models retain their upstream licenses.

widgets_values:
## Automatic relay

Choose **window_frames** on the Person Remover node. H3 uses **17n + 5** frames: **22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124…362**. At 24 fps, 22 = 0.92s, 39 = 1.63s and 124 = 5.17s. **22 is the proven default.** Larger windows need more memory and may drift. Each continuation uses the generated boundary frame as its image reference and the preceding **18 generated video/audio frames** as history. Repeated overlap frames are discarded. The final window shifts or pads as needed, then trims to the source frame count.

Defaults: **12 steps, er_sde, simple, CFG 1, seed 904234**, video/audio sigma shift **12 / 3**, LoRA strength **1.0**. No Turbo or VFX adapter. Select CLIP Device pins Qwen encoding to **gpu:0**. Change strength on Load LoRA; keep the default prompt for a first test.

Generated audio is used internally for continuity. The clean output is **silent** by default. Connect source audio from Get Video Components to Create Video if you want the original soundtrack. Removing someone visually does not remove their voice.

Each finished window appears as a preview card on the Person Remover node before the next window proceeds. Hover to play (tap on touch screens). Use ComfyUI's normal execution controls to stop a run; completed previews remain available. Change the window size or seed, then run again. Lock keeps the prefix through a card. Reroll keeps earlier windows and rebuilds the selected window onward. Full-quality checkpoints survive server restarts. The exact prepared green-masked source is also cached on disk: unchanged rerolls skip SAM detection and tracking. Source or mask-setting changes prepare a new mask. This graph regenerates the full scene; inspect motion, mask remnants and seams.
